explanation: Ray worked as a graphic designer at an advertising agency before he directed films. He received an honorary Academy Award in 1992.

claims.text: Satyajit Ray directed Pather Panchali (1955), the first film of his Apu Trilogy.
Raj Kapoor, Guru Dutt and Mrinal Sen did not direct the Apu Trilogy.
Before directing, Ray worked as a graphic designer at an advertising agency in Kolkata, then called Calcutta.
Satyajit Ray received an honorary Academy Award in 1992.
